releaseNotes: VoxGlow 0.1.0 (first beta): one-window vocal repair and glow. CLEAN removes clipping, crackle, clicks, noise, room tail and pops; SMOOTH tames harsh resonances; BODY adds warmth or cuts mud; FORWARD brings the vocal to the front; AIR adds sparkle and rebuilds missing highs on phone and band-limited vocals. Press LEARN while the vocal plays. Fully close the DAW before installing.
